meta.title: SASALLE | Architectural Excellence
meta.description: A quiet sanctuary shaped by proportion and light. Batam, Indonesia.

home.ritualBody: Architecture is more than form; it is a sensory dialogue between the earth's raw elements and the human spirit. At SASALLE, we curate stillness through stone and linen.
home.materialHonestyBody: Untouched textures that ground the senses in the physical world.
home.quietudeBody: Expansive volumes designed to facilitate a state of effortless being.
home.sanctuaryBody: A dedicated floor for silence, thermal baths, and meditative architectural journeys.
home.diningBody: Indigenous ingredients served on artisanal stoneware by local craftsmen.

rooms.label: RESIDENTIAL ARCHITECTURE
rooms.title: Sanctuaries of Material Stillness
rooms.heritageBody: A dialogue between history and modernity, featuring hand-fired Hijau Nyonya accents and reclaimed timber floors.
rooms.obsidianBody: Defined by its structural purity, this studio utilizes light-absorbing materials to create a cocoon of silence.
rooms.ivoryBody: An ethereal retreat flooded with natural light, featuring lime-wash finishes and organic textures.

spa.intro: Experience SASALLE's spa—a museum of the senses. Here, we honor the permanence of stone, the warmth of clay, and the clarity of water.
spa.thermalBody: Sequential heat and cold chambers designed as a study in circulation.
spa.clayBody: Warm terracotta compresses meet basalt stone in slow, deliberate rhythm.

dining.title: The Brick & Iron
dining.intro: Where European restraint meets tropical material heritage. A study in silence, texture, and form.

loyalty.intro: An experience defined by silence, texture, and time. Progress is measured in stays, not points.
loyalty.vipLogic: Gold members with twenty nights annually receive complimentary suite consideration. Black members receive priority VIP allocation.

book.title: Reserve Your Stay
book.seasonalNote: Seasonal rates apply for peak periods.
book.cancellationBody: Complimentary cancellation until 72 hours before arrival. Within 72 hours, one night is retained.

guest.keyBody: Your suite awaits. Present this pass at the lift gallery.
guest.conciergePlaceholder: How may we assist your stay?
